semantics: Reports are prepared by the existing worker after a qualified operator-released event. Poll GET workspace for actual state, no fabricated report or synthetic success response.
Show scenario/testOnly and received ERP/CRM origin; the pre-existing qualified demand is independent of the later fire.
approved is a human decision. execution.status applied is the distinct committed simulation receipt. Pending HTTP is UI waiting, not a durable Executed claim.

The plan only creates future purchase/transfer orders, source holds/planned allocations and a draft CRM offer. No instant physical stock receipt, accepted sale, realised revenue or real supplier action.
All workspace counts originate in persisted native data. No 10k-line dump in the model path.
Report.assessment contains the calculated plans. planStates supplies decision, simulation and server permissions without duplicating the calculations.
Unknown/blocked/stale states remain explicit. Reuse a pending operationKey after transport uncertainty; first read durable state, never auto-execute a new command.
Industrial questions use the same received ERP/CRM/public-source scope and existing worker. The generic C1 full-commitment tools are disabled for this company.
Until connected, POST industrial/questions returns explicit503 and no queued job. Read-only first checkpoint capabilities are false.
readiness: Types are authoritatively proposed by integrator. Runtime routes and exact integrated sample follow after server implementation; UI may build typed parsers/components with honest loading/unavailable states.
